title: Metal texture allocation descriptor loses Shared storage-mode compatibility
body:
Source-confirmed on main fc22df0; runtime validation on Apple hardware is still needed.

AllocationCreateDesc::texture maps MTLStorageMode::Shared to MemoryLocation::Unknown. Allocator::allocate treats Unknown as a wildcard and selects the first memory type, which is GpuOnly / a Private placement heap. A Shared texture descriptor can therefore receive a Private allocation even on Apple silicon where Shared heaps are supported. The descriptor's size/alignment query alone does not preserve its required storage mode. Creating the resource with that allocation must obey the heap/resource storage-mode compatibility contract.

Reproduction to run on Apple silicon: create a Shared MTLTextureDescriptor, build AllocationCreateDesc::texture, allocate, inspect the returned heap.storageMode(), and attempt newTextureWithDescriptor:offset: using the same descriptor. Expected: compatible Shared allocation or a clear unsupported request error; source currently routes to Private. Managed and Memoryless also collapse to Unknown and deserve an explicit support decision, not an assumed compatible heap.

The sizing/classification changes in #323 do not fix this selection defect. A robust fix must preserve storage-mode compatibility and be tested on Apple hardware. No unvalidated Metal fix is being submitted as verified. [Current source](https://github.com/Traverse-Research/gpu-allocator/blob/fc22df05140b15ed6d764beabd12a1b807011bc5/src/metal/mod.rs).

Agent-assisted investigation and report. Evidence: https://github.com/simzy39/winit-wgpu-repro-benchmarks/tree/main/allocator-reconciliation-20261128
